thread:
IncidentBot: ALERT — P0 generation latency spike in eu-west-1 (tickets increasing). Pager: https://pd.example/INC-789 (auto)
marco (oncall): on it, paging the runtime team. seeing error rate jump + tail latency ~600ms on short prompts.
sasha (sre): ack, will join. do we have a playbook step? @sre-runbook-bot any recommendations?
sre-runbook-bot: RUNBOOK SUGGESTION: 1) Check recent deploys 2) Check KV cache hit rate 3) Fallback routing to model-variant small 4) Notify comms. See commands: `kubectl -n runtime get pods | grep eu-west`.
luis (eng-runtime): i’m looking at metrics — KV cache miss rate jumped at 09:23 UTC. also seeing a couple of OOM restarts on gen-workers-3.
marco (oncall): copying logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:23:12Z gen-worker-3 ERROR kv_cache: eviction_failure key=0x3f2
2026-03-15T09:24:01Z gen-worker-3 WARN out_of_mem invoking fallback
```
luis (eng-runtime): repro: running a stress of small prompts causes cache churn; suspect recent kernel change to LRU eviction threshold.
sasha (sre): can we route eu-west requests to eu-east as short-term mitigation? latency penalty but keeps customer facing availability.
marco (oncall): yes. deploying routing policy change now. `rcli route modify --region eu-west-1 --fallback eu-east-1 --percent 30` (gradual).
anya (product-ops): heads up to prepare statuspage text. i'll draft initial message, want quick review.
comms (comms): pls include impact wording: which customers affected, operations in progress, ETA for next update.
jamie (support): seeing +50 tickets from EU customers, mostly elevated latency and timeouts. adding high-touch customers to list.
anya (product-ops): DRAFT STATUS PAGE (initial):
"We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1. Some requests may experience higher than normal response times (up to ~600ms) and intermittent timeouts. Our on-call and runtime teams are actively investigating and routing traffic to alternate regions to restore normal service. No data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes."
comms (comms): minor wording tweak: change "up to ~600ms" -> "elevated tail latency" and add 'affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream'.
anya (product-ops): updated draft:
"We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1 affecting endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Some customers may experience elevated tail latency and intermittent timeouts. Our on-call and runtime teams are actively investigating and routing traffic to alternate regions to restore normal service. No data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes."
marco (oncall): routing change at 09:27 UTC to 50% fallback applied, traffic shifted; error rate dropped ~20%.
luis (eng-runtime): applying a hotfix to revert the eviction threshold change now. patch rolling to gen-worker pool. `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> 7a3f1b2
sasha (sre): capturing timeline for postmortem. tagging impacted customers and retention for logs increased to 14d for this incident.
comms (comms): publishing initial status page now. publishing note ID: SP-INC-20260315-01 (internal). I'll also send a templated customer ping to top 5 accounts.
jamie (support): sent targeted messages to top 5 customers, included workaround (set region=eu-east temporarily).
anya (product-ops): UPDATE 09:45 UTC DRAFT for status page (periodic):
"Update: Routing policy has shifted ~50% of eu-west-1 traffic to eu-east-1 which has reduced error rates. Runtime team deployed a corrective configuration to KV eviction thresholds; we are monitoring key metrics for stability. Some residual elevated latency may persist for a subset of requests. We will provide another update in 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes."
marco (oncall): metrics look stable at 09:56 — error rate near baseline, tail latency trending down but some nodes still warm-up.
luis (eng-runtime): hotfix fully rolled at 09:53 UTC. rolling restart completed for gen-worker pool with zero traffic loss due to routing fallback.
sasha (sre): performing additional verification: run synthetic short prompt suite across eu-west with 200qps for 5m — passing.
comms (comms): readying resolved copy.
anya (product-ops): RESOLVED DRAFT (status page):
"Resolved: At 10:12 UTC we fully mitigated elevated generation latency in eu-west-1. Root cause: an unintended configuration change to KV cache eviction thresholds that increased cache churn and resulted in elevated tail latency for generation workloads. Mitigation steps taken: rollback of the eviction change, a rolling restart of affected gen-workers, and temporary routing of a portion of eu-west traffic to eu-east. Impact: elevated latency and intermittent timeouts for some requests between 09:23 and 10:12 UTC. No data loss. Post-incident actions include config gating, a test for eviction regressions, and an update to runbooks."
comms (comms): looks good. add: "Customers requiring more detail can contact success@redwood.com" at the bottom.
anya (product-ops): published resolved notice at 10:14 UTC. internal notif sent to SLs and CSMs.
jamie (support): closing related support queue items after customer confirmations. tagging for follow-ups.
marco (oncall): documenting in the incident board. creating postmortem ticket INC-PM-20260315.
sasha (sre): thanks team. quick notes for postmortem: add benchmark for eviction threshold, add a canary for gen-worker restarts, and make routing fallback automation visible in console.
luis (eng-runtime): i'll open PR to add config validation and safe defaults.
IncidentBot: Incident closed. Duration 00:50:41. Attachments: logs archived to s3://incidents/2274001234/, postmortem ticket INC-PM-20260315.
comms (comms): closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
